correctness.rationale: Direct substitution proves \(\dot H=b-(k+1)x^2-\dot x^2/a^2\). Compact invariance gives zero mean generator. Equality forces \(\dot x=0\) on the support and, by invariance plus \(b>0\), restricts support to \(E_\pm\). Exact rational replay checks the algebraic specialization; no finite experiment is used as an infinite proof.

originality.rationale: The source paper supplies the same flow and recurrent objects but states no polynomial coboundary or invariant-measure RMS shell. Searches for the exact equation and equivalent stationary-moment formulations found no statement covering this claim; closest retrieved balance laws are for other systems. The inaccessible 2026 modified-Sprott-C paper is recorded as residual risk rather than negative evidence.
residual_risks: The full text of the 2012 predecessor was not available in the inspected source; it could contain a k=0 special-case average identity, which would not by itself imply the k-dependent 2022 result.
The 2026 modified-Sprott-C paper was only available through metadata in the inspected source, so an independently derived equivalent identity in that inaccessible full text cannot be ruled out.
Unindexed or poorly searchable literature could contain an equivalent coboundary.

value.rationale: The identity is a sharp structural law for every compact recurrent state of the same flow whose hidden chaos and unstable periodic orbits are the source’s main objects. It turns a numerically explored family into an exact RMS/derivative-energy shell, distinguishes equilibria from every non-equilibrium ergodic state, and supplies a direct consistency test for periodic-orbit and long-time computations.
